brief: The autumn bonfire barely reads. Its smoke column is `thick = 0.34 * bon.fire + 0.06 * bon.ember` in drawSmoke (line ~5859) and at 1x against the lawn it is nearly invisible - the one thing on the allotments that is supposed to be seen from across the town. And 2 of 17 kindles land at 20:00 or later, because the holder walks 13 h from a sunrise set-out, so the fire lights after dark on days it should have burned in the afternoon. Make the column read at 1x, and get the late kindles into the daylight - either spawn the holder at the lane gate (a shorter walk) or price the walk at the set-out, per the both-ends rule.
measured: #93's own numbers: 17 kindles over 8 seeds x 27 days, of which 2 land at 20:00+; kindle hours span 13.8-20.4. `thick = 0.34 * bon.fire + 0.06 * bon.ember`. Re-run `probes/bonfire-year.mjs` on HEAD before and after; do not re-derive the window.
successLooksLike: A 1x wide shot at the kindle hour shows the column against the lawn (before/after crop, and a pixel count for the column's own box). Kindles at 20:00+ fall to 0 of ~17 with the total number of fires per season unchanged.
avoid: Do not change bonfireDay()'s K or bonfireWeather() - the rate is right and was priced twice at #93. Thickening the column must not thicken the chimneys: they share drawSmoke.
